svg.title: Indochine interlock network
svg.text: 26 firms in 11 components unconnected to the main graph

g.text: 524 firms, 6,079 interlocks, 12 components (largest 498). Node area is weighted degree; the 11 best-connected are labelled. The other 115 firms in this territory's bundle share no
director with another and so have no place in an interlock network.
